voice.title: How should the AI write in your name?
voice.purpose: It is the style used for e-mails, posts and newsletters. Pick a ready-made one, or let the AI learn it from a text of yours or from your website.

warm.title: Warm and friendly
warm.text: Warm and friendly tone. I use informal address, short welcoming sentences and mention a few details about the area. I sign with the name of the property. I avoid sounding too commercial.

elegant.title: Elegant and refined
elegant.text: Elegant and refined tone. I use formal address, well-built sentences and a polished vocabulary, without overdoing it. I highlight details and the quality of the stay. I avoid exclamation marks and abbreviations.

direct.title: Direct and practical
direct.description: Straight to the point: dates, prices, what to do.
direct.text: Direct and practical tone. I get straight to the point with short, clear sentences: dates, prices and what to do. I use informal address. No roundabout phrases and no emphasis.

playful.title: Cheerful and witty
playful.description: Lively, with a light joke now and then.
playful.text: Cheerful and witty tone. I use informal address and a lively language with the odd light joke, always respectful. Now and then an emoji, never more than one per message.
